fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: ClientInstanceId
fields.about: The client instance id that the client must use in subsequent PushTelemetryRequests.

fields.name: SubscriptionId
fields.about: The subscription id that the client must use in subsequent PushTelemetryRequests.

fields.name: AcceptedCompressionTypes
fields.about: The compression types that the broker accepts for the metrics payload.

fields.name: PushIntervalMs
fields.about: The interval in milliseconds that the broker wants the client to use between pushes.

fields.name: DeltaTemporality
fields.about: Whether the broker wants the client to report delta (true) or cumulative (false) aggregation temporality.

fields.name: RequestedMetrics
fields.about: The metric name prefixes that the broker wants the client to report; '*' matches all metrics.
